headline: Major European Nations Join US-Led 'Pax Silica' Initiative for End-to-End AI Supply Chain Security
summary: This significant geopolitical alignment sees the EU, Germany, the Netherlands, and Greece securing the entire AI supply chain, from chips and critical minerals to energy and compute, under the US-led 'Pax Silica' initiative. It signals a critical pivot away from independent European digital sovereignty, consolidating a powerful US-aligned tech bloc and profoundly impacting global AI infrastructure and semiconductor supply chains.
